Case reference: 2014005760.CaseDesc: On December 23, 1992, Gaétan Rodier was last seen on his snow machine ice fishing on Lake Temiskaming in the District of Temiskaming, Ontario.  Subsequently, Gaetan’s snow machine had gone through the ice, and was recovered by divers, however, Gaétan was never located.

Case reference: 2020014650.CaseDesc: On December 2, 1919, at approximately 5:30pm, Ambrose Small was seen for the last time with his lawyer in his office at the Grand Opera House in Toronto, Ontario.

Coat: Other, Dark colour with velvet collar

Case reference: 2024058495.CaseDesc: Billy Ninine, who is considered to be transient, was last seen at a residence in Southend, Saskatchewan, in late August 2024. His intention was to travel to La Ronge. Billy often hitchhikes to Southend, La Ronge, Saskatoon and Prince Albert in Saskatchewan and has previously travelled to North Bay, Deep River, and visit family in Ottawa, Ontario.

Scar: Unknown, Nose deformation from an injury
Unknown, Deformation of the middle fingernail and loss of cartilage
Unknown, Stitches on leg from surgery and infections
Forehead, Old injuries to the forehead

Case reference: 2020006644.CaseDesc: On July 6, 1980, Andrew Jenkins was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. During the time of his disappearance, Andrew may have been despondent.

Scar: Left Side Of Neck, Two inches

Case reference: 2006023399.CaseDesc: John Allen Bowes was last seen in Nipigon, Ontario getting gasoline on August 15, 1992. He was travelling eastbound toward his home in Kingston, Ontario. John usually wears a baseball cap.

Case reference: 2012020004.CaseDesc: Jafar Imenpour, 74 years of age, who was visiting the Lower Mainland area of British Columbia from Iran, was reported missing on September 25, 2011.  Mr. Imenpour had not returned to his family residence after he had left for a 15 minute walk in Port Coquitlam, B.C. He does not speak English and does not know anyone other than his family in this area.

Case reference: 2010000899.CaseDesc: Wilfred Bruder was last spoken to on February 28 2004 while talking on a payphone at the Willow West Mall in Guelph, Ontario. The mall is located adjacent to the Hanlon Expressway (Hwy 6), which runs north/south through the west end of Guelph. He was suffering from depression and made his goodbyes to his ex-wife and children. Wilfred had a medical history of depression and alcohol dependence, and was consuming alcohol in excess at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2013000039.CaseDesc: Darryl Ferneyhough went missing on the morning of Sunday, May 13, 2001, from Halifax, Nova Scotia.  Darryl was seen at the NRG night club on Gottingen Street at 1:30 A.M., and later seen at 3:40 A.M., running north on Gottingen Street in the area of the Marquee Club.

Case reference: 2006013499.CaseDesc: Vital Vachon was last seen on May 1, 1973 when he departed a bush camp in Lucas Township, near Timmins, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014005629.CaseDesc: On June 23, 2011, Yoo Heo was seen for the last time at a Youth Centre in Toronto, Ontario. At the time of her disappearance, Yoo had recently arrived to Canada from Korea.

Case reference: 2014006747.CaseDesc: Jian Ping Li and her 6 month old baby, Xiao Feng Lu, were last seen at their family residence around 9:40 a.m in Brossard, Quebec on April 30, 2014.  When her husband returned that day, around 2:30 p.m., there was nobody home and the back door was unlocked.  Jian Ping Li's car was still at the residence, however she left without her purse, wallet, credit card, cell phone, money, as well as the diaper bag, the stroller and the car seat for the baby.

Case reference: 2014004857.CaseDesc: On September 21, 1992, David Neufeld, Peter Bentzen and Kenneth Vaughan were seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. The three men had been associating with each other as “runners” in order to smuggle cigarettes into Canada from the United States by means of a boat. David’s vehicle and boat trailer were located at Ashbridges Bay, Toronto. The aging boat that was borrowed from a friend has never been recovered and the three men have not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014006175.CaseDesc: On July 8, 2013, at approximately 5:30 a.m., Jason Bathily and his twin sister, Clarene Bathily, were seen for the last time with their mother, Adelyne Mounga, in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2016030725.CaseDesc: Bryan Twan was reported missing in Quesnel, British Columbia, on June 7, 2016.  Bryan was last seen near Quesnel's West Park Mall and has not been seen or heard from since.

Jacket: Denim, Light Blue, Yellow Drilling Rig Logo
Tattoo: Right Arm, BEV Heart and Unicorn

Case reference: 2014006708.CaseDesc: On April 22, 2014, Andrew George Nicoll was reported missing from his residence near Breton, Alberta. The last reported sighting of Andrew was on April 20, 2014. Extensive search efforts, both on the ground and from the air, were conducted on his property and the surrounding county, but unfortunately with no success.

Case reference: 2014005836.CaseDesc: On July 10, 2012, at approximately 3:30 P.M., Warfa Yusuf was seen for the last time in the area of Rossland Road and Harwood Avenue, in the Town of Ajax, Ontario. Warfa was observed entering a vehicle and was never seen or heard from since.

Mark: Left Ear, Birthmark behind left ear

Case reference: 2012020165.CaseDesc: The remains of this male were found in a forested area immediately north of the Port Coquitlam cemetery.

Teeth: Visible Decay, Missing an upper front tooth on the left side prior to death. The upper front tooth on the right side was angled.
Deformity: Left Knee, Osgoode-Schlatter's disease - bony bump on shin below knee

Case reference: 2014001612.CaseDesc: On July 17, 1975, Renée Larose was seen for the last time when she left her home in the borough of Rosemont-La Petite-Patrie in the city of Montreal, Quebec. No one has seen or heard from her since.

Case reference: 2006002199.CaseDesc: On September 23, 1994, this Caucasian male, was found in a field on the south side of the Rogers Centre (formerly known as the SkyDome) at the far end of Rees Street in Toronto. His post-mortem length was approximately 6’2" and he weighed 162lbs, however, these measurements may not represent his actual living weight and height due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy.

Teeth: Missing several teeth; had a great deal of restorative work done in the past with multiple silver-amalgam restorations

Case reference: 2013000016.CaseDesc: Marjorie Ferris was reported missing when she did not show up in London, Ontario, where she was to visit friends. Her apartment was found secured and intact with her purse inside. Her vehicle was parked in the underground garage at her building. Extensive investigation failed to uncover any information regarding her disappearance.

Teeth: False, Full upper and lower dentures

Case reference: 2014005046.CaseDesc: On June 10, 2007, at approximately 3:45 p.m., Remi Bouchard was seen for the last time on a floatation device in the Bow River near Calgary, Alberta. Remi disappeared into the water after being trapped at the base of the weir.

Case reference: 2014001370.CaseDesc: Irene Godreau was reported missing on August 3, 2002 from the nursing home where she resided in Grand Falls, New Brunswick. Irene, who was 78 years old when she went missing, was last seen on the front porch of the nursing home at roughly 2:30 p.m. on August 3, 2002 and was not seen again. Irene has difficulty walking, which raised concerns for her safety and ability to travel far on her own. A thorough search of the surrounding area was performed but those efforts yielded no trace of her.

Case reference: 2012020170.CaseDesc: An adult male was washed up along the south side of the beach at Stanley Park, near the 2000 block of Beach Avenue at English Bay in Vancouver.

Wallet: Black, Contained pliers and a jack knife
Mark: Forehead, Post mortem abrasion on the right side of the forehead

Case reference: 2013000109.CaseDesc: On October 25, 1996, Huguette Douville was seen for the last time in Montreal, Quebec. Huguette walks with an irregular gait, specifically a hunchback posture and always carries grocery bags, and was known to regularly hitchhike.

Case reference: 2014002684.CaseDesc: Mathieu Landry was reported missing on February 16, 1994, by a traveling companion, while on vacation in Malaysia. Mathieu was renting a cabin at Juara village on Tioman Island in Malaysia, when he went for a walk and never returned. Mathieu's passport, clothing, backpack and other personal effects where recovered from the resort where he was staying and sunglasses belonging to him were found on the beach. Land and water searches involving police divers were done and failed to locate him, Mathieu is presumed to have drowned.

Case reference: 2025019323.CaseDesc: On February 5, 2025 Jennifer Provencal went missing after an argument at her rural home in Forest Grove, British Columbia near 100 Mile House. On April 21, 2025 Jennifer Provencal was reported missing by her sister. Jennifer has not been seen or heard from since by her family which is out of character for her.

Case reference: 2026009994.CaseDesc: Kassandra Schoemaker's nephew advised authorities in February 2026 that she hadn't posted online since 2023. An investigation suggested that Kassandra was last seen on November 22, 2023 when she would have left her residence in Victoria County, Nova Scotia. Kassandra is known to be very active on social media but hasn't had any known online presence since. Kassandra has not been in contact with any of her children, her family or friends.

Pierce: Nose, barbell on the bridge of the nose

Case reference: 2016066833.CaseDesc: On April 26, 1982, an unidentified male was discovered in the Detroit River, near Fighting Island. His post-mortem length was estimated as being between 5'6"-5'8",  however, this measurement may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. It is estimated he was in the water for no more than 6 months.

Jacket: Parka or hooded jacket, which had both a zipper and snap fasteners

Case reference: 2021037317.CaseDesc: On 18 August, 2021, Kari Campbell was seen for the last time in the Durham Bridge region of York County, New Brunswick. Kari has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2014005249.CaseDesc: Peter Cory Butler was reported missing by family on March 24, 2008. He was last seen in downtown Whitecourt, AB on March 15, 2008.

Case reference: 2022006110.CaseDesc: On January 24, 2022, Steven Pinch was last seen in downtown area of Calgary, AB.  Steven is known to frequent the city of Red Deer, Alberta, and the town of Rocky Mountain House, Alberta.

Case reference: 2020008363.CaseDesc: On August 16, 1981, at approximately 1:00pm, Dick Yeagar was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Dick had been evicted from his apartment on August 15, and did not show up to work the following day.

Case reference: 2022016834.CaseDesc: On April 21, 2022, Shawn Miness was seen for the last time doing renovations in a residence in Portage la Prairie, Manitoba. A week prior to his disappearance, Shawn’s mother passed away, and he was despondent.

Case reference: 2014004844.CaseDesc: On September 30, 2006, Aaron Derbyshire, was seen for the last time in the early morning hours in downtown Kelowna, British Columbia.  Aaron, a long term resident of Kelowna, had spent the evening out with friends after a day's work as a local surveyor.

Case reference: 2014003903.CaseDesc: Anthony Kootenay walked away from the Algar Tower fire camp 73 kilometres south of Fort McMurray, Alberta on July 13, 1985 at approximately 3:00 am. In the previous days he was described by colleagues as suffering from mental health issues related to alcohol abuse. It is believed he may have attempted to hitch-hike from the area as a passing motorist spotted someone matching his description. An extensive search by land and helicopter was conducted, however Anthony was not located. Two unconfirmed sightings occurred at the Grand Hotel in Edmonton, AB on December 23, 1985 and January 16, 1986. There have been no sightings since that time.

Shoes: Blue, Running shoes with no laces
Tattoo: Left Hand, Tony on the 4 fingers
Left Arm, A flower with 4 petals

Case reference: 2013000031.CaseDesc: On October 31, 2007, Edward D’Souza went missing from his home in Oakville, Ontario. Investigators believe that Edward travelled to Mumbai, India and may now be living in the Middle East under an assumed name.

Case reference: 2014002740.CaseDesc: On November 17th, 1997, Ferdinand Dauz was last seen in New Westminster British Columbia.  Mr. Dauz was despondent at the time of his disappearance.

Case reference: 2023025594.CaseDesc: On September 17, 2010, Tiamanja Palazzo was last observed in close proximity to the American Falls, in Niagara Falls, New York, USA. Tiamanja was subsequently reported missing by her family a short time later. Tiamanja was despondent at the time of her disappearance.

Foreign Object: Middle Back, Steel rod in back
Tattoo: Right Leg, Mermaid - blue and red

Case reference: 2014005435.CaseDesc: Although it is unconfirmed, acquaintances of Douglas Scott Renz indicate that he may have left the Chilliwack area in early 2009.  Douglas last had contact with friends in the Chilliwack area in February of 2010, they reported him missing that April.

Case reference: 2014030665.CaseDesc: On January 19, 1978, the partial remains of a female believed to be aged between 55-70 years of age, were found in the waters of the Salish Sea, southwest of Victoria, British Columbia. She had moderate arthritis and significant healed injuries to her left ankle and foot. It is believed she was deceased several months or even years before her remains were recovered

Case reference: 2014004464.CaseDesc: Singh Sukmwinder Lebahna was last seen in Montreal, Quebec on February 26, 2004. Singh Sukmwinder left the apartment he was sharing with a friend, taking all his personal belongings, stating he wanted to live in Vancouver, British Columbia. Singh Sukmwinder is originally from India.

Case reference: 2020004223.CaseDesc: On December 24, 2019, Ryan Docherty was seen for the last time by his family in London, Ontario. The last known contact between Ryan and his friends was during the last week of December. On March 6, 2020, his mother reported him missing after returning from an extended trip, and noticing that Ryan had not shown up at her residence to retrieve some cheques.

Scar: Right Hand, 3 inches on the top
Tattoo: Upper Back, Words: "EAZY-E"; gun and bullet
Left Hand, A heart with the name "Jodi"
Left Wrist, 6 eyes inside a triangle
Chest, Doc and Pennywise the clown

Case reference: 2013000024.CaseDesc: Susan Dawson lived with and worked for Terry Murphy for approximately 3 weeks prior to her disappearance. She was last seen in the late hours of 12 November 1985 at a gathering at Terry's home in Neville, Saskatchewan.  On November 14, at approximately 11:55 a.m., a massive explosion occurred at Terry's home. There was no indication that Susan was in the house at the time of the explosion. Investigators suspect foul play and that Terry was somehow involved in Susan's disappearance.

Case reference: 2023068017.CaseDesc: Earl Moberg was last seen on December 12, 2023 at the family home in the River East District of Winnipeg, Manitoba. Earl suffers from dementia, and he has not been seen or heard from since.

Coat: Dark Blue, Green, Parka, dark blue or green

Case reference: 2019033665.CaseDesc: On July 18, 1988, the remains of a male were found in a field on the side of road 132 in Tracy, Québec. A camp was found near the remains.

Case reference: 2017048277.CaseDesc: On August 20, 2017 at 11:00 pm, Christina Cooper was last seen leaving her boyfriend's residence in Niagara Falls, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004406.CaseDesc: On January 2, 1973, Caroline Burns was last seen in the early morning leaving her residence in Molanosa, Saskatchewan. Molanosa is a small isolated community approximately 70 kilometers south of La Ronge, SK. Extensive searches of the area at the time failed to reveal any trace of Caroline.

Teeth: Visible Missing, Missing left top molar and left front tooth
Mark: Right Knee, Burn mark on side of either left or right knee

Case reference: 2014002368.CaseDesc: On June 11, 1969, at approximately 5:50 p.m., the Happy Valley-Goose Bay RCMP received a report of an empty boat drifting in Lake Melville, in the vicinity of North West Point, in North West River, Newfoundland & Labrador.  Police attended the scene and learned that this empty boat belonged to Lawrence Alton Oliver, who had departed his residence earlier that morning to go seal hunting.  It is believed that Lawrence fell overboard while hunting and drowned, his body has never been located.

Boots: Rubber, Brown, Red, Rubber hip waders with a red band

Case reference: 2018060326.CaseDesc: On June 10, 2018, sisters Bérénice and Bérengère Paré were last seen at the Ottawa International Airport in Ottawa, Ontario. Bérénice and Bérengère, along with their mother, boarded a flight destined for Russia to visit with family. To date, the siblings have not been returned to Canada.

Case reference: 2014002370.CaseDesc: On June 16, 1997, at approximately 4:30pm, Kelvin Zdarski and two friends left Dauphin, Manitoba and drove to a cabin near Waterhen, Manitoba. During the evening there was an argument between the men. Kelvin left the cabin and never returned. The men looked for him on their way back to Dauphin but did not see him. On June 17, around 7:30am, a man fitting Kelvin's description was seen walking on a local road. An extensive search by land, air and water proved unsuccessful. Kelvin did not take his wallet, money or identification with him and had no means of transportation.

Scar: Left Calf, 1 inch long, back of calf

Case reference: 2026037187.CaseDesc: On July 11, 2026, Joshua Gates was reported missing in Victoria, British Columbia.  Joshua may have travelled to the Lower Mainland or Northern British Columbia area.  Joshua has not been seen or heard from since.

Mark: Left Eye, Small birthmark above left eyebrow
Scar: Mouth, Possibility of a minor scar on the lip

Case reference: 2014001355.CaseDesc: Aurèle Massey was last seen on August 8, 1983 in Montreal, Quebec. Aurèle left his residence to have his vehicle repaired, but never returned. Aurèle was despondent at the time and had mentioned that he wanted to jump into the Soulanges Canal in the Montérégie area of Quebec.

Case reference: 2006018599.CaseDesc: Richard Rees and Gregory Cook were last seen on July 17, 1998, leaving Sunnyside Beach, Nottawasaga Bay in Meaford, Ontario in a Schwill DS16 sailboat. The overturned sailboat was recovered, but Richard and Gregory have not been located.

Mark: Upper Back, pale birthmark on right side

Case reference: 2014001664.CaseDesc: On September 12, 1982, Harold Larcher and his girlfriend set out on Lake Winnipegosis in separate canoes with their supplies from the Overflowing River in Manitoba. After the river, they were in view of big waves on the lake. Their canoes began to fill with water from the same waves.  His girlfriend's canoe overturned, but she could see that Harold was still in his canoe as she struggled to right her own. She was unable to do so, but at one point she was able to sit on it and eventually made her way to shore, but never saw Harold again. Numerous personal items were recovered, including Harold's passport and a lifejacket that may have belonged to him.  It is presumed that he drowned.

Case reference: 2014001105.CaseDesc: The skeletal remains of a man were found along with camping gear in a wooded area near Chute Lake, BC in November 1991. He had a chip in one front tooth. It is estimated that he may have died several years prior to the discovery of his remains.

Jacket: Wool, Black, Suit coat, Herringbone pattern
Shirt: Cotton, Blue, White, Button-down Lumberman flannel
Shoes: Leather, Brown, Lace-up dress shoes, re-soled

Case reference: 2019062419.CaseDesc: On October 28, 2019, Laureen Fabian was reported missing by her husband in Houston, British Columbia. Laureen was last seen walking in the Buck Flats area of rural Houston at 12:30 p.m. and has not been seen since. Lauren's routine typically involved taking walks, though these were generally limited to a duration of three hours. Laureen was wearing dark coloured clothing.

Case reference: 2014004849.CaseDesc: In the evening of November 21, 2006, Yves Castonguay left his residence in Bécancour, Gentilly sector, Quebec. Yves may have been spotted a few times, however he has had no contact with his family since this date. The family of Yves have reasons to fear for his health and safety.

Case reference: 2012020096.CaseDesc: On September 17, 2008, Kevin Michel was with two other people at Usinne Lake, near Creighton, Saskatchewan, harvesting rice. Witnesses state Kevin walked away from their camp for reasons unknown. Extensive ground, air and water searches were conducted in the area but failed to locate Kevin.

Tattoo: Left Upper Arm, "Kevin heart bombers" (text) or "Kevin (heart symbol) bombers"

Case reference: 2014003230.CaseDesc: James McGrath was reported missing on May 31, 2001, by family members.  At the time of his disappearance he was residing near Patrick's Cove, Newfoundland & Labrador.  James lived alone, and was last seen walking on the roadway approximately seven days before his disappearance.

Case reference: 2014001907.CaseDesc: Mary Rose Keadjuk was last seen between late June and August 1990 in Yellowknife, Northwest Territories, and was reported missing in September 1990. At the time of her disappearance, Mary Rose was residing at the Gold Range Hotel. In 2003, partial human remains were discovered in Yellowknife, and forensic DNA analysis determined that the remains were those of Mary Rose Keadjuk in 2018. The investigation into her disappearance  is still active and ongoing.

Teeth: Dental records indicate 1 tooth treated and 6 teeth absent.

Case reference: 2018051391.CaseDesc: On September 2, 2018, Himat Singh was last seen at the Ontario Khalsa Darbar Temple in Mississauga, Ontario.  Himat, who was in Canada on a Teaching Visa, packed a bag and was observed entering a vehicle with an unknown individual.

Case reference: 2020035556.CaseDesc: On the night of August 31, 2020, Cory Westcott was seen for the last time in Bonnington, located approximately 10 minutes outside of Nelson, British Columbia. Cory was reported missing to the Nelson Police Department on September 4, 2020.

Teeth: Gold crown on upper front left tooth
Backpack: Other, Multi-coloured side bag, Supreme brand
Tattoo: Neck, Unknown tattoo across front of neck

Case reference: 2014003808.CaseDesc: On June 10, 1979, Edward McMichael was seen for the last time when he was staying at the YMCA in downtown Vancouver, British-Columbia. He previously travelled to the Yukon and Alberta and worked in the mining industry.

Case reference: 2014002220.CaseDesc: Melvin Hoel was last seen on May 12, 1997 in the Cataract Creek Provincial Recreation Area, Alberta, where his vehicle and all his belongings were found by Fish and Wildlife agents.

Case reference: 2010000599.CaseDesc: Bradley Allan Taylor was on his way home to Enfield, Nova Scotia from London, Ontario. He spent the night in Brockville, Ontario at the Travelodge Motel.  On January 10, 2009, he left the motel in the morning and later that day police found his car abandoned near a railway crossing in Roussillon, Quebec. Many of his personal belongings were found in the car. Police searched the area but Bradley was not located.

Hair: Brown, Long, Straight, Beard, Moustache, Sideburns

Case reference: 2014005315.CaseDesc: Darryl Dubitski was last seen by his family leaving his residence in Edmonton, Alberta in December of 1982. Darryl had informed his family that he was travelling to the United States.

Case reference: 2012020142.CaseDesc: On September 10, 2008, Shannon Alexander, 17 and Maisy Odjick, 16, were reported missing from the First Nation community of Kitigan Zibi in Quebec. This community is located near the town of Maniwaki. On September 5, 2008, the two girls went to the Maniwaki arena, where several young people were present. Maisy then went to spend the night at Shannon’s house. Shannon’s father was the last person to have seen his daughter on September 6, 2008. In 2015 an age progression was done for both Maisy and Shannon.

Pierce: Mouth, 2 loops on the lower lip

Case reference: 2014005673.CaseDesc: Tanya Nepinak was last seen leaving her home in downtown Winnipeg, Manitoba on September 13, 2011 to go shopping and has not been seen or heard from since. Tanya has always been in contact with her family and this behaviour is out of character for her.

Tattoo: Left Hand, Letters "T A N Y A" on each finger

Case reference: 2014001111.CaseDesc: On February 7th, 1994, the remains of an adult male (25-50 years old), 5'10-6'0 tall, with a thin build, were located by land surveying students in a wooded area near the village of Anmore. The investigation determined the cause of death to be a self-inflicted gunshot wound. A black guitar case was found near the remains. He went missing sometime after May 1992.

Belt: Black, Blue, Fabric belt with a metal Indian Chief Belt buckle inscribed "HARA"
Jacket: Cotton, Blue, Blue with Green Gold piping sleeved Windbreaker Jacket
Pants: Nylon, Blue, Maroon, Sweat pants with zipper on cuffs
Shirt: Cotton, Grey, Black, Long Sleeved Sweatshirt

Case reference: 2019073876.CaseDesc: On November 1, 2019, Anton Katona was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2012020016.CaseDesc: Rhody Lake disappeared on Sunday, November 27, 2005.  She was last seen going for a walk in Sechelt's Porpoise Bay Provincial Park located in Sechelt, B.C.

Hat: Red, Orange, Toque - might be beige

Case reference: 2012020081.CaseDesc: Emily Osmond (Laplante) lived a reclusive lifestyle on a small acreage on the Northern edge of Kawacatoose First Nation. Emily seldom had contact with her family or friends and the last known contact with them was August 29, 2007. She was last seen on the 9th of September, 2007, by her hired helper. Her disappearance is very unusual. Her vehicle and personal belongings including medication were left at her residence. She also had dogs at her acreage that she cared for that were left unattended. Searches of the area have failed to locate any sign of Emily.

Case reference: 2016068414.CaseDesc: On August 30, 1965, this unidentified male was found on the shore of Lake Ontario just east of the harbour pier in Oshawa. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 160 lbs, however, this may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. His appendix was present and he was not circumcised.

Teeth: Decayed teeth; gold inlay and prosthesis in his upper dentition; lower dentition had an amalgam filling
Shoes: Leather, Veritough, one left shoe; size 7
Scar: Right Upper Arm, circular puckered scar 1" in diameter on the anterior right underarm

Case reference: 2014004050.CaseDesc: On Saturday, June 25, 1994, Stephen Tudor was participating in a one man (solo) sailboat race from Port Huron to Mackinac Island.  The sailboat he was sailing, the "ANERIRIN" was located abandoned along the Goderich, Ontario shoreline. Police were unable to locate any signs of Stephen.

Case reference: 2014005443.CaseDesc: Paolo Renda was last seen on May 20, 2010 in the Montréal-Nord borough of Montreal, Quebec. Paolo's vehicle was later located on Gouin Street in Montreal. Paolo has not been seen or heard from since.

Case reference: 2006010299.CaseDesc: On November 11, 1970, at approximately 4:00 p.m., Edward Bucharest and his son, Barry Bucharest, were last seen by their family members in Kenora, Ontario. The pair had left from their cottage located on Kimberly Road, north shore of the Big Stone Bay in the municipality of Lake of the Woods, in a 14-foot fiberglass boat. The capsized boat, two life jackets, and other belongings were subsequently located.

Jacket: Green, Parka, with gold pile lining
Wool, Red, Black, with gold pile lining

Case reference: 2025067893.CaseDesc: The skeletonised remains of this young adult male were discovered in a ravine in Burnaby, British Columbia, on October 15, 2025. It is likely that he was missing for up to 18 months prior to being found, and he had sustained an injury to his right foot, which had become infected.

Case reference: 2015033938.CaseDesc: On the morning of June 27, 2015, Curtis Wilson was seen for the last time by a friend in Kelowna, British Columbia. Curtis had travelled from Alberta to British Columbia in a black rental car, model Chrysler 200. Subsequently, the rental was recovered in an area off Cosen Bay in the Kalamakla Provincial Park in Coldstream, British Columbia.

Shirt: Black, TSHIRT, Orange logo on front of shirt
Tattoo: Right Forearm, Skull in top hat 'Wicked'; skull outer forearm
Right Forearm, Skull with snake through it, $$ signs & flaming skull
Left Chest, Eagle head; upper chest
Left Forearm, Red & black scorpion on inside forearm
Right Upper Arm, Three skulls, inside bicep
Right Upper Arm, Skull, outside bicep

Case reference: 2014001046.CaseDesc: On July 23, 1990, the body of this middle-aged man was found on Gore Avenue in Vancouver, British Columbia. He died of complications related to chronic alcohol dependence.

Hair: Blonde, Long dark blonde hair with greying beard
Jacket: Denim, Blue, Young Life Creator brand
Shoes: Grey, Nike Air brand, running shoes

Case reference: 2006025499.CaseDesc: On September 11, 1976, Anthony Malinak and friends arrived at Long Lake and fished during the day. That evening Anthony had taken a boat from Mountain Lodge on Long Lake. The boat was found at the east end of the lake in a foot of water.  His rain jacket and hat were found in the boat. He is presumed drowned.

Case reference: 2019029100.CaseDesc: Robert Allen Wetsch was reported missing by family on May 19, 2019. There have not been any confirmed sightings of him since.

Case reference: 2014002117.CaseDesc: On January 13, 1996, Michelle Harmer was reported missing by an acquaintance of the family who last spoke with her on October 31, 1995. The last contact Michelle's family had with her was in early November 1995.

Case reference: 2014002467.CaseDesc: Gerald Ivan Geake was last heard from by his family in February 2002. At that time, it was believed that Gerald was living in Edmonton, Alberta.

Case reference: 2014005200.CaseDesc: Conrad Hastings was last seen on March 3, 2008 at the bus shelter at Smith Street and Portage Avenue in Winnipeg, Manitoba.  Conrad's whereabouts remain unknown.

Case reference: 2014002334.CaseDesc: Gary Percival was reported missing in Regina, Saskatchewan, on April 9, 1973. A witness did state that Gary may have been a patient in a hospital in New York State in 1974. He has not been seen since.

Case reference: 2021056970.CaseDesc: On November 12, 1998, the remains of an unidentified woman were recovered from North West Connoire in Newfoundland. The woman had a complete fusion of the proximal and intermediate phalanges of her right ring finger. This fusion would have rendered her joint completely immobilized.

Case reference: 2014003425.CaseDesc: Christopher Giberson went missing from the Saint John Regional Hospital on January 28, 2000, at 7:00 p.m. in Saint John, New Brunswick. Christopher was taken for treatment and then assessment but he walked away before being seen by staff and has not been located since.

Case reference: 2020007968.CaseDesc: On May 30, 1977, Aurelio Ferreira was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario. Prior to his disappearance, Aurelio was despondent.

Case reference: 2014004517.CaseDesc: Edmee (Eva) Mitchell, 83 years old, went missing on August 20, 2004. Mrs. Mitchell was last seen at her rural residence near Kelly Lake, British Columbia.

Case reference: 2014001029.CaseDesc: On February 11, 1992, the body of this man was discovered on a beach in the vicinity of Hesquiat, located on the west coast of Vancouver Island, British Columbia. He had sustained a previous injury to his right knee, which had resulted in arthritis, and he was likely to have originated from the United States.

Fractured/Broken Bones: Right Knee, Compression fracture of the right proximal tibia, accompanied by arthritis

Case reference: 2014004543.CaseDesc: Marguerite Cardwell was last seen in Calgary, Alberta on September 10, 1973, when she informed a friend of her intention to travel to either Edmonton Alberta or Vancouver, British Columbia. Marguerite's vehicle was subsequently discovered in the vicinity of Canmore, Alberta, on September 16, 1973. It was noted that her purse and other personal belongings were found inside the vehicle.

Fractured/Broken Bones: Left Ankle, 2 inch screw in ankle

Case reference: 2012020018.CaseDesc: Sahil Sharma has been missing from the Newton area of Surrey, B.C. since November 13, 2008.  On the day Sahil disappeared, he had attended to Kwantlen University in Surrey, B.C. to pay for his upcoming semester to study Information Technology.  Sahil did not have any known drug or alcohol addictions and no known mental health issues.  Sahil's disappearance is highly out of character and all avenues of investigation have not provided any information on his whereabouts.

Sweater: Grey, Red, Red stripes on the neck
Tattoo: Right Forearm, "RAM" written in Hindi symbols

Case reference: 2019044701.CaseDesc: On August 5, 2019, at approximately 6:00 am, Bridget Dalbe was seen for the last time in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014005453.CaseDesc: On December 9, 2004, Sheila Adamo was seen for the last time when she left the family residence in Ottawa, Ontario. She is known to travel to the East Coast as well as into the United States.

Case reference: 2022006217.CaseDesc: On February 14, 2022, Jessie Morrissey's mother reported him missing from Amherst, Nova Scotia.  Jessie was last seen travelling in a dark-coloured Jeep Patriot in the Springhill area on the morning of February 13. The Jeep Patriot he was travelling in was located on snowmobile Trail 104 in Leamington, Nova Scotia later that evening.

Case reference: 2017060881.CaseDesc: Harold Dupuis was last seen on October 15, 2017, drifting uncontrollably in the St. Lawrence River, about 0.8 kilometers off the Ste-Anne-des-Monts wharf in Quebec. At the time of his disappearance, Harold was working on a fishing boat and accidentally fell overboard.

Case reference: 2009004999.CaseDesc: At the time of her disappearance, Dawn Carisse was a patient of the North Bay Psychiatric Hospital. She is generally very pleasant though suffers from short term memory loss due to cardiac arrest several years earlier.  Dawn always spoke of leaving the hospital and going to where she believed her family would be. Her family was in the Kirkland Lake area and then moved to Sudbury. She was aware of both, and her possible destinations were Kirkland Lake or Sudbury. She was last seen on Highway 11 North, in North Bay, Ontario.

Hair: Brown, Curly, Parted in centre, short bangs
Dress: Maroon, Pink, Long dress with faint white flowers, short sleeves and front buttons.
Luggage: May have had a dark duffle bag in her possession.

Case reference: 2014025774.CaseDesc: In August 2014, Pawel (Paul) Przybyla was reported missing by his family. He was last believed to be in the Edmonton, Alberta area.

Case reference: 2014002562.CaseDesc: Michael Megraw, from Minnesota, USA, had visited the Katamik Lake area in Manitoba with his brother to go fishing over the September Labour Day weekend in September 1992.  Michael had returned to the US, but he was reported missing just days later. His family indicated that he was last seen on September 11, 1992.  On October 3, 1992, the RCMP received a call regarding a truck that had not been moved from Katamik Lake since September 24th. Michael Megraw was identified as the registered owner.  It is believed that he returned to the lake between September 11 and 24, 1992. Michael has not been seen since.
